meta.title: Change default hotstuff-min-timeout for collection nodes to 1s
meta.body_summary: Reduce collection node hotstuff-min-timeout default from 1500ms to 1000ms to align with SN timeout (1.045s) and reduce impact of offline nodes on finalization rate.
